senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אית; cmp. אִית, עוּת, אִישׁוֹן, אֲשַׁן)essence, permanent or normal condition.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 48b:18">Nidd. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>חזר לאֵיתָנוֹ</he> obtained again its normal condition.
<cite ref="Sotah 36b:14">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>שבה קשתו לא׳</he> his membrum resumed its normal condition. (Cmp.
R. Hash. 11ᵃ א׳ לישנא דתקיפי ethan means strong.— Pl. אֵיתָנִים.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אֵיתָנֵי עולם</he> the mighty of the world (patriarchs).
Gen. R. s. 98 (play on ăthono Gen. XLIX, 11) בנים אֵתָנִים וכ׳ mighty sons (heroes) are destined to descend from him.
